rationale: This checks whether the fixed replay supplies the reproducible failure needed to start delta debugging. If baseline passes and full-delta fails cannot be confirmed, reduction cannot begin. Establishing these starting outcomes instantiates the unchanged procedure without adding a new mechanism, evidential bridge or target requirement.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: Run repeated baseline and full-delta configurations against the identical fixed replay workload, apply the pre-stated predicate, estimate run-to-run variation, and confirm that baseline passes and full-delta fails.
